discrepancies.finding: Stale workers could overwrite canonical {job_id}.glb before fenced commit rejection, deleting valid artifacts.
discrepancies.remediation: Artifacts written to immutable generation-specific paths ({job_id}_gen{gen}.glb); canonical pointer updated conditionally only after state commit.

discrepancies.finding: assert_ownership() accepted a client-supplied is_admin: bool parameter, allowing potential privilege escalation.
discrepancies.remediation: Removed client boolean parameter; introduced TrustedSecurityContext requiring server-side cryptographic HMAC signature.

discrepancies.finding: UnifiedJobState stored mutations in Python memory with threading.Lock, failing to synchronize across OS processes.
discrepancies.remediation: Implemented DurableJobStateManager using POSIX fcntl.flock on {job_id}.lock with atomic fsync replacement.

discrepancies.finding: IdempotencyRegistry stored keys in a Python dictionary, losing registrations across restarts or separate processes.
discrepancies.remediation: Implemented DurableIdempotencyRegistry backed by POSIX O_CREAT | O_EXCL file creation, returning 409 on mismatched fingerprints.

discrepancies.finding: Queue multi-process tests were only evaluated on 4 processes and 20 jobs without simulated crashes.
discrepancies.remediation: Executed 8 independent OS processes claiming 500 jobs with simulated crash of worker 0 and supervisor recovery.

discrepancies.finding: Aggressive MAXLEN trimming risks deleting pending messages from PEL before acknowledgment.
discrepancies.remediation: Documented hazard; prohibited aggressive stream trimming; specified retention policies > 50,000 entries.

discrepancies.finding: GLB validator only inspected 12-byte header and JSON chunk, ignoring buffer bounds and external URI security risks.
discrepancies.remediation: Implemented validate_glb_deep_structure() inspecting bufferViews, accessors, mesh primitives, and rejecting external URIs; added Three.js runtime parser test.

discrepancies.finding: 4,200 MB model resident and 1,800 MB activation VRAM were synthetic estimates labeled as measured values.
discrepancies.remediation: Transparently documented estimations as unverified; labeled CUDA as BLOCKED; provided reproducible CUDA profiling blueprint.
